responsibilities: Build and maintain BI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions for risk management and business decision-making.
Strong Risk Analytics knowledge is required.
Capital market/ Credit Risk experience is mandatory for VP position.
Develop solutions using direct query BI platforms such as Astrato, Sigma, or similar tools.
Design and optimize reporting data models using Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
Partner with business, Risk, Technology, and Data Engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver insights.
Leverage AI and code generation tools, such as Claude Code or similar platforms, to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.
Implement custom UI integrations, embedded analytics, and workflow driven reporting capabilities as needed.
Contribute to BI architecture, dashboard standards, performance tuning, governance, and analytics best practices.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Experience with data quality, reconciliation, lineage, access controls, and reporting governance.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: testing, governance, data quality, reconciliation and 'data accuracy' outnumber the speed phrases ('accelerate development', 'rapid prototyping', 'fast-paced environment') by more than two to one, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: measuring, quantifying, analyzing, reporting, and controlling exposures across market and credit
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: the dashboards serve an investment bank's market and credit risk oversight, with 'regulatory reporting' named in the experience list, so high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: major transformation projects involving the end-to-end build of a modern, highly scalable, risk platform
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: an existing risk technology group and data engineering teams are rebuilding the platform and still forming 'dashboard standards', so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop solutions using direct query BI platforms such as Astrato, Sigma, or similar tools.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: the duties name the actual platforms and practices (astrato or sigma direct-query bi, snowflake reporting models, claude code), so hiring_manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: BI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions for risk management
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: the primary audience is the firm's risk management group overseeing market and credit exposures, a finance-and-control audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to BI architecture, dashboard standards, performance tuning, governance
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: the verbs are build, develop, implement and 'contribute to', with no define or own, so execution.
evidence.ai_role: Leverage AI and code generation tools, such as Claude Code or similar platforms, to accelerate development, testing, and documentation.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: the candidate is expected to use ai coding tools to speed up their own development, testing and documentation.
evidence.testing_framing: The role will involve the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of risk analytics
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: testing is part of the stated duties, alongside reconciliation and reporting governance in the experience list, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: troubleshooting issues and resolving production problems
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: production issues and data accuracy are concerns, but delivery leads and regulatory reporting appears only as preferred experience, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: end-to-end build of a modern, highly scalable, risk platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: the role builds a new risk platform while also maintaining and tuning existing dashboards and models, so mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Proactive in identifying risks, escalating issues, and following through to resolution.
